_readme: Text for the in-game phone: News, agent Messages and the Kickfie feed. Every text is tied to a real career event (see scripts/core/news/career_event.gd for event types and their {placeholders}). Common placeholders: {player}, {position}, {age}, {season}; events with a club also get {league}. Variants: season_played.great/steady/poor (by season rating, see thresholds), retirement.inducted/not_inducted. Texts for the same event variant are used in rotation, so the same career always reads the same and stories do not repeat back to back. Keep it kind: this game is for young players. No links, no real names.

season_played.great.headline: {player} shines in a superb season
season_played.great.body: A season rating of {rating} took {player} from {overall_before} to {overall_after} at {club}.
